name: velixir Free Web App Hosting
free_limit: One provider-hosted free web app per account, 0.25 vCPU, 256 MB RAM and 1 GB temporary disk; scales to zero on idle, wakes on HTTP request; custom domain and TLS supported.
watch_out: Free app sleeps when idle, causing cold starts; its 1 GB container disk is ephemeral across deployments. Managed PostgreSQL, Valkey, persistent volumes, paid replicas and always-on compute cost extra. One-time signup credits are separate from the permanent Free app. Commercial-use permissions are not explicit in public Free-plan documentation; check provider terms.
